## PCI/system PM callbacks that reach `i915_pm_suspend`

```text
PCI PM core

       -> i915_pm_suspend(struct device *kdev)

            -> if switch_power_state == DRM_SWITCH_POWER_OFF

                 -> dev_priv = drm_i915_private
                 -> display = dev_priv->display
                 -> intel_display_driver_suspend(display)
                 -> intel_irq_suspend(dev_priv)
                 -> ...
```

Relevant locations:

- `.suspend = i915_pm_suspend` — `i915_driver.c:1719`
- `i915_pm_suspend()` — `i915_driver.c:1392-1404`

### Hibernation poweroff

```text
PCI PM core
```
